name: oracles
description: Hedera oracle template with Foundry contracts and Chainlink, Supra, and Pyth adapters.

steps: This template uses Hedera oracle providers. Chainlink and Supra are push-style reads, while Pyth requires fresh update data before reading.
4. Run a provider fork smoke test, for example: {run:foundry:test:chainlink:testnet}
5. Deploy an oracle adapter to Hedera testnet, for example: {run:foundry:deploy:chainlink:testnet}
9. Extend this app with the co-versioned harness recipe: {run:harness:extend}
After this, customize the supported pairs, provider config, contracts, or frontend to fit your product.
